bio: Kosmozoo is a European DJ collective and Burning Man-affiliated soundcamp founded by Piccaya, a DJ with roots in Belgium's early-1990s new beat scene. The project runs a weekly downtempo/world-fusion radio show on ShoutingFire Radio (Sundays) and operates the KosmoZoo soundcamp at Nowhere, the Pan-European regional Burning Man event in Spain.
burning_man_history: No confirmed appearance at the flagship Black Rock City event; founder Piccaya runs the KosmoZoo soundcamp at Nowhere, the Pan-European regional Burning Man event in Spain, and is described as an active member of the Burning Man community.
camp_affiliations: KosmoZoo (soundcamp at Nowhere, Spain regional burn)

bio: Mr. Jennings is a Portland, Oregon-based bass music producer working across drum & bass, trap, glitch hop, and space bass, with a sound described as psychedelic and built for wall-of-subwoofer sound systems.
notable_releases: FLOW (2025 digital release, 4 tracks); LURCH CHURCH (March 2024); Delinquent Habits remix (Jan 2025); Jungle remix (Dec 2024)

bio: Grease Withaspoon is a multi-genre bass/hip-hop DJ known for playful, unconventional 'weird bass music' sets.
burning_man_history: Played 'Wipe it off Wednesday's,' a sausage-sizzle/dance party at The New Barbarians camp, Burning Man 2018 (Wed Aug 29, 2018, 1-2:30pm).

bio: Crowsnestster co-hosts 'Crowsnestster & Pooch - Live from Bull Shoals,' a Sunday-morning multi-genre music-and-talk show on ShoutingFire Radio, a broadcasting collective described as inspired by Burning Man.

SILKWORM (DJ SILKWORM) is a tech house DJ/producer originally from New York, now based in Denver, Colorado, self-described as the 'Tech House Goddess.' She has opened for The Knocks and has served as DJ Booth Coordinator for the 1st Friday NoBo Art District in Denver since August 2020.
burning_man_history: Listed appearance at Burning Man Decompression 2021 (Denver-area decompression event); her promo materials also state she performs at 'major festivals including Burning Man.'

bio: Dirty Texans is an Austin, Texas house-music act blending house production with country 'twang and grit,' formed in 2023 with roughly 11K monthly Spotify listeners.

Black Panda (Eddie Rios) is an Oakland, California-based DJ/producer, writer, and community builder originally from Brooklyn, who draws on his Nuyorican heritage to blend Caribbean soul with house, techno, minimal, and disco. He founded the event project Pandamonium.music and co-founded the BIPOC Beats Collective, aimed at uplifting artists of color at Burning Man and beyond.
notable_releases: iEuphoria (feat. Almost All-Purpose); Gabby's Business Hours (with Gabby Windey)
burning_man_history: Has performed at Burning Man on art cars and at camps including Heavy Petting Zoo, Fauxliage, Opulent Chill, The Sound Garden, Entheos, and Bubbles & Bass; co-founded the BIPOC Beats Collective to uplift artists of color at Burning Man.

bio: Contessa (also billed as DJ Contessa / Contessa UV) is a Los Angeles/Hollywood-based techno DJ and producer known for a dark, bassy techno sound. She has released on UK label Krafted Underground and performed at events including Genius*Loci FEST.
notable_releases: "Augury" (solo) and "Chrysalis" (with JJ Flores), both on the DTLA (Deep Tech Los Angeles) compilation

bio: Beat Kitty is a Bay Area bass-music producer/DJ with classical training, blending hip hop and metal influences across bass, halftime, drum and bass, house, trap, and global rhythms. She runs the side project ThirstRap with Thug Shells and has played EDC Las Vegas, Elements Festival, Camp Bisco, and The Untz Festival, among others.

Igor Marijuan is a veteran Ibiza DJ and co-founder/Artistic Director of Ibiza Sonica Radio for over 15 years. He is a member of the All Day I Dream (ADID) roster and currently serves as Music Director of Akasha Ibiza and Ibiza Global Radio, playing deep, organic, melodic, and disco-tinged house.

Seth Schwarz is a Germany-based DJ/producer and classically trained violinist who fuses live violin performance with electronic music; by day he works as a radiation oncologist. He began blending violin and electronics at underground venues like Monkey Safari's Charles Bronson club.
notable_releases: Melodies From The Dust EP (Do Not Sit in the Furniture Recordings); Eden EP (3000 Grad Records); Eisheimer EP (Katermukke); Darjeeling Train (Bar 25); The Bar Tender (All Day I Dream); Nothing Happens By Chance (Einmusika Recordings); From The Dust (Bandcamp album)
labels: 3000 Grad Records, All Day I Dream, Katermukke, Bar 25, Einmusika Recordings, Do Not Sit in the Furniture Recordings

bio: Iman Rizky is a New York City house/melodic house DJ and promoter who came up through the late-1980s/1990s NYC club scene (Tunnel, Limelight, Sound Factory, Twilo), promoting at the Tunnel, Limelight, and the Palladium before turning to DJing. He founded the WICKEDLIQUID project, which debuted internationally in Jakarta and Bali, Indonesia in 2001, and co-founded ebb + flow music with Gavin Stephenson in 2013.
notable_collaborations: Gavin Stephenson (ebb + flow co-founder); Luis Diaz (2002 UNIKO Tour of Southeast Asia)

bio: Amanda Gaez is a Los Angeles-based electronic/techno artist and vocalist blending techno rhythms with trap/future bass elements. She has performed at Boulevardia (Kansas City), Exchange LA, and Sound Nightclub.

Buddha Bass is the collaborative/remix alias of Soulfood & DJ Free, an award-winning Santa Fe, New Mexico producer/composer whose scoring credits include IMAX, Disney, PBS, and National Geographic, with 27 independent releases and 2 major-label releases. The project blends acoustic instrumentation with global grooves and transglobal electronica on the Soulfood Music label.
notable_releases: "Buddha Bass" compilation album (feat. Desert Dwellers, Kaminanda, Variant Field, Pumpkin, Quade, Govinda, Kayla Scintillla); remixes of "Tantric Body," "Euphoria," and "Enigmatica"; "Kiss The Sky (Buddha Bass Remix)" of Shawn Lee
notable_collaborations: Desert Dwellers, Kaminanda, Variant Field, Pumpkin, Quade, Govinda, Bartek, Morillo, ChrisB.
